question: "And then One Day: A Memoir" is an autobiography of which of the following Bollywood star?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naseeruddin Shah.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"And then One Day: A Memoir"** is an autobiography of **Naseeruddin Shah,** a veteran Bollywood actor known for his versatile acting skills.
 
• The book was published in **2014** and covers his childhood, struggles as an **actor, and personal life.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shahrukh Khan** has written an autobiography titled** "Twenty Years in a Decade"**.
 
• **Karan Johar** has written a memoir titled **"An Unsuitable Boy".**
 
• **Priyanka Chopra** has written an autobiography titled** "Unfinished."**
 
• **Autobiographies** and memoirs are popular genres in the entertainment industry, as they offer insights into the** personal and professional lives** of celebrities.
